title: PullbackSectionsIsColimit
statement:
Let $I$ be a preorder, $D:I^{op}\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ an inverse system
[def-pc-scheme], $c$ a cone with vertex $X$ and projections $f_i:X\to X_i$, $i_0\in I$,
$\Lambda$ a commutative ring, $G$ a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $(X_{i_0})_{et}$
[def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and $V_0\to X_{i_0}$ an etale object
[def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Put $J=\{i\mid i_0\le i\}$ and write $a_i:X_i\to X_{i_0}$
for the transition morphisms. Set $S_i=(a_{i,*}a_i^{-1}G)(V_0)$ and
$T=(f_{i_0,*}f_{i_0}^{-1}G)(V_0)$, using the direct and inverse images
[def-weil-pbc-direct-image], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. For $i\le j$ let
$b_{ji}:X_j\to X_i$ be the transition, so $a_j=b_{ji}a_i$ in diagrammatic order.
Define $\mu_{ji}:S_i\to S_j$ to be, on $V_0$ sections, $a_{i,*}$ of the unit
of $b_{ji}^{-1}\dashv b_{ji,*}$ at $a_i^{-1}G$, followed by the direct-image
composition isomorphism and by $a_{j,*}$ of the inverse-image composition
isomorphism $b_{ji}^{-1}a_i^{-1}G\to a_j^{-1}G$
[lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. Define $\tau_i:S_i\to T$ by the
same formula using $f_i$ instead of $b_{ji}$ and the cone equation
$f_{i_0}=f_i a_i$. Assume additionally that $I$ is directed, every $X_i$ is quasi-compact
and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], all transition morphisms are affine
[pqf-def-affine-morphism], $c$ is a limit cone, and $V_0$ is affine. For every functor
$F:J\to\Lambda\text{-Mod}$, cocone $B$, isomorphisms $e_i:F(i)\to S_i$ and
$e_B:B.pt\to T$ satisfying $e_j F(i\to j)e_i^{-1}=\mu_{ji}$ and
$e_B B_i e_i^{-1}=\tau_i$, the cocone $B$ is a colimit cocone
[def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

proof.text: Use the underlying-set section comparison for fixed module coefficients to obtain equivalences q_f on every stage and the limit, commuting with the canonical triangle maps μ and τ. These equivalences require no scheme limit or colimit hypotheses.

Affine V₀ is compact and quasi-separated; the qcqs target makes its structure morphism quasi-compact, and quasi-separatedness of the source makes it quasi-separated. Apply the existing set section lift on the upper tail, convert its Over-index to an element i≥i₀, and pull its representative back through q_i. Comparison compatibility gives a module section mapping to the prescribed limit section.

Compare a stage section with zero. Their images on the limit agree. Apply set section eventual equality to q_i(s) and q_i(0). The two arrows in the resulting Over-category are equal because the original index is a preorder. Translate the common target to the upper tail and use q_j injectivity and linearity μ(0)=0 to obtain eventual zero in the module system. No zero-preservation property of q itself is assumed or needed.

Transport lift and eventual zero through the supplied isomorphisms e_i and eB. Every element of the chosen filtered module colimit has a representative. Lifting proves surjectivity of colimit.desc F B. For injectivity, use the kernel criterion for an additive map: if a colimit class has zero image under desc, choose a stage representative; its image under the cocone leg is zero. Eventual zero supplies a later transition where this representative vanishes. The colimit cocone equation then makes the original class zero. The bijective linear desc is an isomorphism; use its induced cocone isomorphism to transport the chosen colimit universal property to B.
